messages:
jamie: Quick check — planning a 2h maintenance smoke test this Friday 00:00-02:00 UTC. Need ~8 A100s in eu-west1 (standby/soft-reserve). Can we confirm availability or agree a fallback? cc @sara :eyes:

leo: We currently have 4 reserved in eu-west1. Another 4 are available via partner lend, but need a quick approval and terraform slice. If you can give a hard window I'll ping procurement.

sara: I can approve the lend if finance signs off on the short-term cost delta. How many vCPU / RAM per node you expecting? and are we ok with spot-backed H100 fallback?

jamie: It's just inference smoke — small instances, 80GB RAM per node is fine. Prefer A100 for parity with prod, but H100 spot is acceptable if latency variance is documented.

alex: If we fall back to H100 spot, add this env tweak so runtime prefers low-latency kernels: `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_PREFER_H100_KERNELS=true` — also set `MAX_PREFETCH=2` for the smoke. That avoids big mem spikes.

leo: Noted. I'll open the lend request with vendor and attach the terraform PR. tagging @sara for approval.

vendor-bot: Reservation check: eu-west1 A100 pool = 4 reserved, partner-lend pool = 6 available. ETA for partner provisioning: ~45m after approval. Reference: ticket RW-5321.

jamie: Thanks — can we aim to finalize approvals by Thursday EOD? If partner takes >1h to provision we'll move test to next quiet window.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-5379 to track approvals + terraform slice. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/ RW-5379

sara: I'll fast-track finance sign-off for a one-off lend up to 8 nodes. Leaving a note on RW-5379 with cost cap.

leo: PR for terraform carve is here: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/842 — needs one more review (cc @alex). If merged now partner can start provisioning.

alex: Lgtm, left one minor comment on the PR about tagging. Once merged I'll update the runtime flag in the smoke config.

jamie: Perfect — will wait for PR merge and confirmation. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
